identity.alias_note: Shared verified alias map with the ESPN DDF leg (data/inputs/player_aliases.json); suffix, punctuation and nickname spellings match through norm_player_name (FixtureIdentity). Unresolvable identities are excluded, never guessed.

inputs.per_game_note: per-game = Razzball's published PPG columns (rz_std_ppg / rz_half_ppr_ppg / rz_ppr_ppg). Doubling-quirk safe: the Games column and counting totals are 2x; the PPG columns are canonical. Arithmetic on Razzball components only; no expert blending.
inputs.pies_note: Positional pies measured from the current Razzball data (tier surplus). No pies file: a static file goes stale when the player pool changes.
